tweets.text: 🇨🇳 While the Strait of Hormuz crisis was sending oil prices into panic mode, China seems to have stumbled into a very convenient backup plan: 3 billion electric taxi trips a month. About half of China’s 1.3 million taxis are electric, close to 100% in major cities. So when gas got pricier and the Iran war kicked off in February, people did the sensible thing and let somebody else do the driving. The result: taxi trips jumped 6%, China burned 10% less gasoline and 14% less diesel in May, and road travel still hit record highs. Source: Reuters / Writer: Monica

Je réfléchis aussi à organiser des lives réservés aux abonnés, avec des échanges plus directs et des sujets plus approfondis. Rien n’est encore décidé, mais ça pourrait arriver très bientôt. Merci à tous ceux qui me soutiennent déjà. ❤️ nitter.net/brivael/creator-subscr…
